Dieser basiert auf dem Muster in Anlage 3 zu dieser Leistungsbeschreibung und gilt für die in Anlage 1.2 aufgeführten Abnahmestellen. normalized.description: The objective of this activity is to implement and deliver a data service for Space Weather data based on a Hosted Payload approach. The following set of measurements shall be provided in near-real time from a Low Earth Orbit with an altitude around 1000 km:oThe flux of energetic electrons (0.3 - 3 MeV) and protons (10 - 200 MeV), as present in Earth's radiation belts and from Solar Particle EventsoThe flux of thermal electrons and ions (10 eV to 24 keV) to measure the 3D distribution of precipitating particles.The lifetime of the hosting mission is expected to be at least 5 years, so that the data service could be provided for an extended amountof time, while the activity only covers the first year of service provision.
